glass_bottle_jar.note: Glass bottles and jars; no drink glasses or window glass

plastic_bottle.note: Plastic containers, bottles, jugs and tubs

plastic_tub.note: Yogurt and sauce tubs; dirty food containers go in garbage

plastic_bag_film.note: Plastic bags, wraps and wrappers go in garbage

cardboard_box.note: Flatten cardboard; labels and tape are okay

pizza_box_greasy.note: Food-soiled pizza boxes go in compost, not recycling

paper_cup.note: Page does not list coated paper cups; check the Where Does It Go tool

milk_carton.note: Cartons not named on this page; check the Where Does It Go tool

foam.note: Foam trays, instant food containers and blocks go in garbage

aluminum_foil.note: Clean foil trays are accepted; clean foil only
